title: UniCAR-RL: Seeing Better before Thinking Deeper in Visual Mathematics
abstract: arXiv:2609.13849v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with complex mathematical visual reasoning primarily due to a lack of fine-grained perception, causing initial visual hallucinations to directly trigger cascading reasoning failures. In traditional end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL), sparse rewards fail to decouple perceptual hallucinations from logical missteps, hindering targeted perception optimization. Alternatively, fine-tuning with perception-enhanced CoT data incurs high costs and hallucinations. In this paper, we address these challenges by proposing UniCAR-RL, an annotation-free RL framework. By explicitly decoupling the optimization of perception and reasoning during the training process, it achieves isolation and optimization of both capabilities. Specifically, UniCAR-RL consists of three synergistic branches: 1) a Caption-RL branch that optimizes perception capabilities through verifier-guided reasoning validation; 2

translated_title: UniCAR-RL：在视觉数学中先看得更清，再想得更深
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在复杂的数学视觉推理中常常表现不佳，其主要原因在于缺乏细粒度的感知能力，导致初始的视觉幻觉会直接引发级联式的推理失败。在传统的端到端强化学习（RL）中，稀疏奖励无法将感知幻觉与逻辑错误解耦，阻碍了针对性的感知优化。另一种方案——使用感知增强的思维链（CoT）数据进行微调——则成本高昂且伴有幻觉问题。在本文中，我们提出UniCAR-RL，一个无需标注的强化学习框架，以应对上述挑战。通过在训练过程中显式解耦感知与推理的优化，该框架实现了两种能力的隔离与优化。具体而言，UniCAR-RL由三个协同分支组成：1）一个Caption-RL分支，通过验证器引导的推理验证来优化感知能力；2）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出UniCAR-RL——一个无需标注的强化学习框架，通过在训练中显式解耦感知与推理的优化（包括Caption-RL等三个协同分支），解决多模态大模型在复杂数学视觉推理中因细粒度感知不足导致的幻觉与级联推理失败问题。
en_tdlr: UniCAR-RL is an annotation-free reinforcement learning framework that explicitly decouples the optimization of perception and reasoning—via three synergistic branches including Caption-RL—to address fine-grained perceptual hallucinations and cascading reasoning failures in complex visual mathematics for MLLMs.
